description.en: From the Cathedral neighborhood through Dayangdang to upland Carolina.

narration.en: Aling Cely’s serves kinalas on Dimasalang Street. A 2015 profile names its owner as the main cook and describes more than three decades of service.

narration.en: At Kinalas Twin, the noodle bowl can gain brain slices, egg or chicharon, with puto cheese alongside. Edwin Rey began developing his recipe in 1990.

narration.en: Cha Kamot’s Corregidor Street kinalas helped popularize this Naga comfort food. Dateline Ibalon describes a following spanning roughly two generations.

narration.en: Mang Kok’s began as a home-based kinalasan in 2015. Its Solid Street menu includes beef, special and lechon kinalas.

narration.en: The flight east ends at Didick’s in Carolina. Its special kinalas adds egg, chicharon and special meat; turones, paksiw and dinuguan round out the menu.
